//: Feature flags from configuration, and the enablement switch of a bundled module. Keys live under the
//2: 'FeatureManagement' section (Microsoft.FeatureManagement's default), so Azure App Configuration can
//3: feed the same shape later with no code change. Precedence: config -> DB/admin toggle -> catalog default.
//4: For a module bundled by build-time PackageReference (see Stomme.Application.Server.csproj), the key
//5: 'module.<id>.enabled' decides whether it is SEEDED onto a page at install (and thus renders). <id> is
//6: the module's display name lower-cased, whitespace removed (e.g. 'Blogs' -> module.blogs.enabled). A
//7: value of false suppresses seeding even though the assembly is present; true or ABSENT seeds as normal,
//8: so a stock app that ships this file with no module keys behaves exactly as before.
